observed.detail: Single workbook illustration: rear cab, long constant-width hood, dark neutral charcoal paint, cream lining, brass handrails; reference contains no second/rear view.
Four hood-facing cab panes (owner-corrected count) under a curved roof. Narrow side pane and a larger cream-framed sliding window; retain the observed arrangement.
Rounded hood shoulders and separate side access panels with fine horizontal louvres. Five larger panel divisions are visible, not six identical narrow doors.
One exhaust, rectangular roof grille, two substantial round fan housings nearer the nose, one flared brass horn. No extra rooftop fittings.
Short dark roof pipe and flared brass bell with a visible rim/crown; replace the prior plain cone silhouette.
Two cast grey bogie sideframes with paired openings, prominent axleboxes, dark wheel treads; rounded central fuel tank.
One circular nose lamp above cream lining; vertical radiator grille; steep cream safety chevrons on front pilot, narrow access steps.

This pass: broad cast bogie sideframes with two rounded openings are clearly exposed below the walkway. Previous frame was too far inboard and the axle spacing too short. Re-author frame, place it farther outboard without moving the rail-contact treads, and expose more of its height.
This pass: hood-facing windows occupy more of the cab face and their upper line follows the arched roof. Add the cab gable behind them and restrained pane reflections.
This pass: fan housings/spokes are dark charcoal, not bright silver star patterns.
This pass: bell has a curved flaring skirt, not a straight cone.
This pass: nose lamp has a substantial round housing, ring and warm lens.
Owner correction: exactly FOUR cab-front windows. Previous five-pane interpretation was wrong.
Circled central tank must be visibly exposed under the walkway in the isometric game view. Its side face reaches nearer the chassis edge and lower than the v3 model.

inferred.detail: The opposite side uses bilateral construction symmetry for the structural shell, running gear and the visible-side access layout; it is not a verified second-side drawing.
Overall model scale and hidden interior/axles are functional simplifications. They are not prototype measurements or image-proven mechanical drawings.
Rear shell closure is plain; coupler/step structure is minimal functional geometry. No specific unseen rear livery or glazing is asserted.
Model-unit dimensions remain illustration fitting, not engineering measurements: bogie axle spacing 1.80, frame centre across +/-1.10, body suspension clearance +0.18. Tread gauge remains unchanged.

omitted: Unreferenced badges, pipes and roof details
guidelines: Only references/01.png determines appearance. It is losslessly converted from the original workbook image, with original-file hash retained. No in-game mesh, game screenshots, fit/gear table, online photograph or reconstructed mesh may determine shape. Keep the approved C50 construction and lighting method; colours follow this PNG. Unknown hidden details remain minimal and explicitly inferred. Owner approved the method, not these revised details yet. Latest owner correction takes precedence: four front panes; visibly exposed central tank. Otherwise preserve v3. The blue circle is an annotation, not a paint/detail input.
